additional_info.subject: ID0430436-DC/Si-D/IT-[MP / T1 170004338] Charging Issue With DC Power Supply CRM:00314000175
additional_info.body:
Buonasera Valerio,
I am writing you via the ticket to report the outcome of our conversation together with Product Champion from today.
During our call, we clarified that from our side the chargers in Rome are behaving correctly, in terms of power delivery and noise limitation.
After a clarification with R&D, I reported to you that the FW
v6.1.3-ATAC-0-g350b281
has no bug, as the FW is intended to include the feature request of Noise limitation, also known as Silent Mode or Quiet Mode.
This feature is
intended to be used with 400kW charger & 6 converters. The functions will limit the charger noise emission to 51dBA at 1m away from the charger while enabling to output 200kW for at least 1h.
Silent Mode can be turned on while charger is turned on and no charging session is active
During Silent Mode, some components will be limited
Converters: each 40kW converter will be limited to 33.34kW
main fan: limited to max 42% speed
automation fan: turned off
This means that, when charging in parallel two buses, 6 converters * 33.3kW =  200kW max power limit for the whole charger, so 100kW per outlet in parallel.
Please also consider the configuration of the chargers: the chargers are Sicharge Ds Gen 2 (400kW), with installed power of 240kW, in Low Flex configuration. 6 converters of 40kW each installed, 3 converters per converter group. This means that, when charging in parallel, the maximum power per outlet physically installed is 120kW.
With the Silent Mode active, and when charging in parallel, the charger is actually delivering 20kW less per outlet, but all 6 converters are in use to provide 100kW per outlet.
As we discussed today, the topic is not a service topic anymore, as the behavior of the charger is correct and there is no issue with it, but it is rather a clarification over a feature request. As per agreed, please approach PLM (Jens Amarell) to further discuss the expectations of the Silent Mode, the future technical developments in the roadmap and the feasibility of any adjustment of this feature request.
I will proceed to close this ticket.
With kind regards,
